caption: The drawing depicts a transparent, light blue-green glass vessel with two ornamental handles on opposite sides of the body. The vessel has a wide, slightly flared rim and a rounded bowl that narrows near the base before transitioning into a short, thick stem, which is attached to a circular, flat foot for stability. The surface of the bowl features decorative, raised, wavy patterns, and the handles are curved with small detailing at the joints. The drawing is rendered with fine lines and shading to indicate the glass’s smooth and translucent quality, and is centered within a plain, off-white background bordered by a fine line. There is a faint signature that reads “Joseph Delaney” in the lower left corner.
title: Sugar Bowl
